target.native_fixture_mode: copied saved spans; no game process

fixture.link: MSVC Win32 /MD /EHsc /O2 /fp:strict, /MANIFEST:EMBED; primary bsp_core.lib, bsp_lua511.lib and bsp_zlib121.lib

construction: Each independent run builds a valid all-black balanced seven-node outer integer map (node20h, nil1Dh; signed keys -20,-10,-5,0,5,10,20). Every outer node owns an independently allocated three-node inner integer/scalar map (node18h, nil15h; black root, red children), with distinct scalar payloads. Heads, parent links, extrema, counts, colors and pooled allocator ownership are initialized explicitly.
comparison: After each operation, snapshots normalize pointers into ordered shape and compare outer and inner counts, nil/color, signed keys, scalar payloads, parent links, head extrema, and returned owner/node. A subsequent full erase also checks cleanup after each partial case. Snapshot traversal asserts visited node count equals header count.

cases.case: root erase with deeper right-subtree successor

limits: This is an isolated copied-body fixture, not the installed game process or gameplay validation.
The AQ manifest lacks 0055B490, so both populated copied maps are destroyed with the source wrapper after their topology snapshots; native copy ownership cleanup was not compared independently.
The fixture and runner live in ignored local/ and are pinned by hashes in this report; the report is the only committed artifact.
Cases use valid consistent balanced trees and supported copied-body boundaries; malformed tree, exception and native FH3 behavior remain outside the comparison.
